notes: New: Collect Payment for whole family in one go (per-child discount/amount, multi-month arrears, pending School Items shown/collectible, live discount-sync), combined family payment receipt showing Received/Pending per child and for items. Fixed: family/daily-collection/fee receipts no longer lose signatures or totals for large families or heavy accounts. New-install sidebar now shows only popular modules by default; Settings and Sidebar Customization can no longer be accidentally hidden. Demo/sample data now shows a Dashboard banner with a one-tap Clear button. Fixed emoji/symbol glyphs not printing on early-learning worksheets.
